explanation: The Jacobian matrix is [[v²,2uv],[2u,2]], whose determinant is 2v²−4u²v=2v(v−2u²). It vanishes exactly when v=0 or v=2u², giving the union of the line and parabola.

answers.correct_value: The critical points lie on the line $v=0$ and on the parabola $v=2{u}^{2}.$
answers.wrong_value: The critical points lie on the line $u=2v.$
